_meta.note: per-species, per-gender fur draw tables recovered from AnimalPopulationScanner.exe; the fur is a deterministic function of the save's VisualVariationSeed
_meta.draw: state = (seed * 0x343FD + 0x269EC3) mod 2^32; u = ((state >> 16) & 0x7FFF) / 32768; roll = int(u * totalWeight); first entry whose cumulative weight exceeds roll wins
